messages:
maria: Uploading cedar-8b weights + tokenizer to S3 now. Will attach manifest and checksums. Need provenance + registry entry before we run quant experiments. Target: baseline evals by EOD Friday.
kevin: Thanks — link? and do we have KMS envelope setup for the bundle?
maria: s3://redwood-models/cedar-8b/cedar8b-v1.tar.gz
      sha256: 3b2f9c8a9d... (pasted in full in manifest)
      tokenizer sha1: a7f5d3e9e0c2
      manifest (short):
      ```
      name: cedar-8b
      version: 1.0
      files:
        - cedar8b-v1.tar.gz
        - tokenizer.json
      checksums:
        - cedar8b-v1.tar.gz:3b2f9c8a9d...
        - tokenizer.json:a7f5d3e9e0c2
      kms_key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01
      ```
kevin: KMS alias is alias/redwood-models — good. I'll enqueue a provenance validation job (checksum + manifest signature).
ops-bot: Artifact received: job=artifact-validate-4821 status=queued (started by kevin) :package:
anya: Quick Q on tokenizer: was this a merged fastBPE or new sentencepiece? tokenizer.json says spm (v0.2) — we should run tokenization parity tests vs the training tokenizer.
maria: It's sentencepiece trained during preproc. I included training commands in the manifest.
kevin: Running parity check now: `python -m tools.token_check --model s3://redwood-models/cedar-8b/ --samples 1000`
sam: FYI for registry path naming: let's follow /models/<name>/<flavor>/<version>. So registry entry should be /models/cedar-8b/float/1.0 and later /models/cedar-8b/quant/nf4-4bit/1.0 etc.
maria: Good call. For quant experiments, I want a quick sweep: PTQ with nf4 4-bit baseline, then GPTQ-style 4-bit sweep (nf4 vs q4_0), and a 8-bit fallback. Keep prompt set small: 500 QA + 200 long-context summaries.
kevin: Proposed pipeline:
```
1) validate artifact (checksums, manifest sig, tokenizer parity)
2) register float artifact in Registry (path + metadata + kms tag)
3) run smoke serve on dedicated dev pool (seq len 1024) to capture latency/cost baseline
4) run quant job (bits=4, method=PTQ/GPTQ variations) with calibration set (500 samples)
5) run eval suite (qa, summarization, toxicity) and produce regression diffs vs float baseline
```
anya: Can we gate auto-promotion? If any eval metric drops >1.5% absolute or hallucination increase >0.5% we block promotion.
maria: Agreed. Also add per-route latency SLO check — 99p token latency must be within 1.3x of float baseline or we label as high-latency quant artifact.
kevin: Registry-bot: please create draft entry when validation passes.
registry-bot: Draft registry entry created: path=/models/cedar-8b/float/1.0 id=reg-5892 status=pending-metadata
ops-bot: artifact-validate-4821 status=passed (checksums ok, manifest signed, tokenizer parity ok) :white_check_mark:
kevin: Pushing float artifact into registry now, tagging with provenance: uploader=maria, source=internal-acq, commit=git@repo:abcd1234, kms=alias/redwood-models
maria: I'll kick off the smoke serve on dev pool after push. Can someone reserve 1xA10 dev node for 2 hours tomorrow morning?
\sam: I'll reserve dev-a10-05 from 09:00-11:00 PST and add to calendar.
anya: For quant jobs, who owns the calibration/bit-sweep orchestration? I can own the eval harness and metric diffs if kevin can run the quant pipelines.
kevin: Yep I'll own quant pipeline runs. Plan to run initial PTQ nf4 4-bit sweep + GPTQ replicate tomorrow afternoon, then export metrics to /evals/cedar-8b/2026-03-20/
maria: One more: please include a full inference trace (token-level latency + memory peaks) for each run so we can assess perf regressions. Use the runtime flag `--trace detailed` on dev serve.
kevin: noted. I'll also generate per-token cost estimate using the cost model.
anya: I'll prepare the eval prompt set and a short smoke test (50 samples) to run as pre-check before the big sweep.
maria: Thanks all. Next steps summary: kevin validate+register float (today), maria smoke serve (tomorrow morning), kevin quant sweep (tomorrow afternoon), anya run evals + gating (after quant). I'll update the manifest with the eval dataset pointers.
kevin: Opening a tracking ticket in board: MLENG-8232 and linking registry entry.
registry-bot: registry entry reg-5892 updated: linked ticket=MLENG-8232
ops-bot: Reminder — ensure S3 lifecycle for the tarball is set to private and encryption=aws:kms.
sam: Confirmed S3 ACLs set to bucket-owner-full-control and server-side encryption enabled.
maria: Great. If nothing blocks, we'll aim to promote a qualified quant artifact next week. Thanks everyone :rocket:
kevin: +1 :thumbsup: 
anya: leaving notes for postmortem capture: keep quant hyperparams, calibration set seed, and eval snapshot in registry metadata.
registry-bot: final status: reg-5892 state=active metadata={"eval_snapshot":"/evals/cedar-8b/2026-03-20/shot-0","provenance":"manifest-v1"}
kevin: Closing this thread — will post links to logs and results under MLENG-8232 when ready.
maria: thanks, bye.
